propositions: When prompted-branch structured parsing exhausts OUTPUT_RETRIES, the raw LLM reply is discarded and the failure is not replayable without opt-in artifact capture.

A new config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir (resolved on LLMConfig via _llm_str in from_env, with env alias REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR) enables optional local capture of failed parse attempts.

On final parse failure in _pai_structured, when the key is set to a non-empty path, write a timestamped artifact file containing reply text, model id, contract name, and attempt count, then append its path to the raised error message.
Artifact write is best-effort and never masks the original parse error; the key defaults to None (no behavior change); rotation keeps at most 20 newest artifacts per directory by mtime.
The feature is confined to the prompted reask loop and must be documented in docs/config.md with default, env alias, and rotation semantics.
